content: Iesu Bethany nan Simutai
Ra nimtereban kaita si’yen on nanai on Baisobon an ra itgat, Iesu on inai au bethany, menan Lazarus imama nan, on orot on Iesu rabob emon ibobaimisirai.
Osi on rabirabi an bayu on nan Iesu aurin sibotitiwag, ato Martha on ibaisis bayu iteteb; Lazarus on osi sabu mat sanasi imair Iesu mat kemai bayu si’yam.
Namon Mary on fio yanden ninibin an baiyan gagamin on kibub auman ibo inat ato Iesu annai idebur isur ato toun tefanai on ann isafanen. Fio yanden ininib on goa amon engon ibonu.
Iesu an baigibubunuotin tani wabin Judas Iscariot—on min Iesu itkaseirai mes—on iyau,
“Om aibo mes atonio fio yanden ninibin an baiyan 300 kina nanaba on men sabu auris uttobon ato agim utboai sabu kokoianis utites i?”
On atonio dura ikakafun on men sabu kokoianis kaifares aurin on, baise on toun on bainauotin. On orot on baibad sitai agim an kukufet ikakaifarai auman iboai ibibib, ato agim turin ibabainau auman.
Baise Iesu iyau, “Jever eikirir mom! Bobo aifan ifofour on innonosin ato au garob an ra ingat.
Omi arimon ra fufur sabu kokoianis mat wonama baise omi men ra fufur Yau mat tanama on.”
Priest Aiwabis Sidudurai Lazarus Sitasubun Mes
Sabu kuayo gagamin dura sitatam Iesu on Bethany nan, on mes osi sinai nan, osi men sinai Iesu wat aurin on, baise Lazarus mat sititai, ato Iesu rabob emon ibobaimisirai on.
On mes priest aiwabis asi bainonot on sidudurai Lazarus mat sitasubun mes,
yabin atonio bobo Lazarus aurin imamatar emon on Jew yangan on osi Jew babadis sibisisiweiis ato Iesu on sibitutumai.
Iesu Aiwab Ba au Jerusalem Irui
Ra itom sabu kuayo gagamin on sinat Baisobon an Forag aurin on nan dura sitatam on Iesu enat au Jerusalem.
On mes osi yafi rorous siyaburutoben sigat sinai Iesu sitnefotai mes, osi sibiyoku si’yau, “God tanifain! God On inimomoginai on Bada Wabinai enat! God on Israel yangan asi Aiwab inimomoginai!”
Iesu foro donkey igaturai ato tefanai igai imair ato God an dura buk amonai sigayam si’yau ba,

content.text: “Zion mafam gagamin, omi men wonaber mes! Omi ami Aiwab on atonio foro donkey boboun tefanai igai imair enat.”

content: On an baigibubunuotis on atonio bobo aurin on ainau men sisagob; baise on an rai God on Iesu rabob emon ibobaimisirai iAiwabai weie, osi on nan sinos On aurin on God an dura buk amonai sigayam ato osi atonio bobo On aurin sifour.
Sabu kuayo on Iesu mat nan an rai on Lazarus rabob emon ibobaimisirai ato iyawur rasi emon ibib igat, ato bobo aifan imamatar aurin on sabu sikasones.
On fasinai sabu kuayo on sinai Iesu sinefotai—yabin osi dura sitatam On atonio bobo buburin faiwarin ifour.
Pharisee yangan on tous wat siyau bonen, “Omi woit, ot bobo tafofour wat men fofonin tanyafotai on! Woit, sabu tafanam au engon tutufin on On sebigibubunuai!”
Greek Sabu Fani Iesu Sinuen
Sabu fani on si’nan au Jerusalem on Greek sabu fani on amosi on mat sinai Jew yangan asi Forag an rai sitkwafir mes, on mat nan.
Osi sinai Philip aurin (on min Bethsaida mafam gagamin Galilee tafanam emon) ato siyau, “Bada, wei wagogoi Iesu wanitai.”
Philip on inai Andrew iyawur, ato osi rus sinai Iesu sikasonai.
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Wera ari inat on sabu engon tutufin sinsagob Orot Natun on God ba.
Yau awurem dura bag: Sawareg inafeu motobai ato inafim, on arimon sawareg uwas sigaraba sinou. Ato sawareg men inafim on arimon kaitamom nana inen.
Iyai iyafan toun an yawas ebinuaboai on arimon inisiwanai; iyai iyafan atonio nin tafanamai toun an yawas ebisisiweiai on arimon yawas mama wantoanin inbotan.
Iyai iyafan egogoi Yau iniagireu on Yau inigibubunueu, onai Yau menan nan annanan on arimon au agirotin rui wanan. Ato iyafan Yau inbiagireu on Tamau arimon inifain.”
Iesu An Rabob aurin Ikakafun

Iesu an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “Ari on Yau nunuau ebiyababan—ato Yau abi dura anau? Yau anau, ‘Tamau, men atonio wera unikirir innat auriu mes’? Baise Yau on fasinai anat—onai Yau atonio werai on anikokosariu mes.
Tamau, Om Wabim duram gagamin on ebo egat sabu eiyoboes!” Namon fonan safam emon ikakafun iyau, “Yau Tou Wabiu durau gagamin on abo agat, ato Yau on arimon bobo anafour men.”
Sabu kuayo gagamin nan sitatawar on fonan sitatam ato sabu fani siyau, “Wanferer irab.” Ato sabu fani siyau, “Anea aurin ikakafun!”
Baise Iesu on osi auris iyau, “Atonio fonan ibikakafun on men Yau auriu on, baise omi aurim on ikakafun.
Ari wera on God tafanam inigurubabanai; ato on arimon atonio tafanam an bainetewarotin on ari inreberirai insur.
Yau atonio tafanam emon sinbogaiiu anag nabai anarab on, Yau arimon sabu engon tutufin anboes sinnat auriu.”
(Iesu atonio dura ikakafun on ebiyoboet an rabob mamaba inboboai aurin on.)

Sabu kuayo gagamin on siyafotai siyau, “Ot ati Baifafaro dura ikasonet on Orot Rurubinin on arimon inama au wantoan. Ato Om mamaba uyau on Orot Natun on sinbogaiai inag nabai inarab? Ato atonio Orot Natun on Iyafan i?”

Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Tafa on men weromin arimon omi sanamui inen on. Tafa bisimui yen on nana wonabib wonnanan, onai wouman on men intaragabuem mes; iyafan ato woumanai ibib enan on men isagob menan nan ibib enan.
Tafa bisimui yen on On wonitutumai onai omi on arimon tafa an sabu wonmatar.” Jew Sabu Men Baitutumotis Iesu ato dura iyau gibunai on, osi sabu ikirires inai mabinai nan iyob.
Basit Iesu on atonio osi bobo buburis engon osi sabu nasi ifouren min on, baise osi On men situtumai on,
onai aubairuruotin Isaiah dura aifan i’yau on inat idura bag: On iyau,

content.text: “Bada, wei dura wabikakafun on iyafan intatam initutum? Sabu iyabon auris on Bada an faiwar rerebai ibo igat iyoboes i?”

content: On yabinai osi engon tutufin men fofonin sititutum yabin Isaiah mat iyau,

content.text: “God on osi matas ibofofoten a nunuas irufofoten onai osi men matas siteit men, a osi nunuas on men fofonin sitsagob. God iyau, osi men fofonin Yau auriu sinrutabir aniyawasis on.”

content: Isaiah atonio dura iyau yabin on Iesu an Aiwab it on God ba ato on aurin ikakafun.
Baise Jew babadis sigaraba on Iesu situtumai; ab Pharisee yangan auris siber on mes osi men fofonin On aurin on wasai nan dura sitikakafun on, ari osi bayoi goa emon sityatetis sitgat on mes.
Osi asi nuabo on sabu ra engon osi sinbifais, ato osi men segogoi God osi inifais on.
Iesu An Dura Ibikakafun nan on Sabu Inigurubabanis
Iesu fonan gagaminai iyau, “Iyai iyafan Yau ebitutumeu on men Yau ekesiu wat, ab Iyafan Yau ibiyafareu on mat ebitutumai.
Iyai iyafan toun matanai Yau i’teu on ato Iyafan Yau ibiyafareu on mat toun matanai eitai.
Yau on tafa ba nin anat au tafanam onai iyai iyafan Yau inbitutumeu on men womanai inama mes.
Iyai iyafan Yau au dura etatam ato men ebifonabo, on men arimon anigurubabanai on. Yau anat tafanamai on men sabu anigurubabanis mes, ab Yau sabu aniyawasis mes.
Iyai iyafan Yau ebisisiweiiu a men egogoi au dura inboai on ato dura on inmisir inigurubabanai. Dura ato aikakafun on arimon ra kanfounai on on orot inigurubabanai!
Atonio on dura bag yabin Yau men Tou au baibadai dura aikakafun on baise Tamau On ibiyafareu on dura wawaninai iyawureu mamaba dura anau a anikakafun.
Ato Yau asagob On an dura wawanin aifan i’yau on yawas mama wantoanin ibo inat. Yau Tamau dura mamaba iyawureu atikakafun mes on ato aikakafun.”
